recommended_clarification_nonblocking: If a future weighted enumeration theorem is stated universally over all planes, make the uniform-in-plane fixed-C quantifiers explicit before diagonalizing to one universal growing f(q). The existing elementary baseline already has uniform bounds.
strongest_verified: Uniformly for every existing projective plane as q tends to infinity, q+sqrt(q)+1 <= tau(R) <= (1+o(1))*q*ln(q) with high probability; explicit all-q>=4096 failure and upper bounds are proved in REPORT.md.
exact_remaining_gap: No argument excludes all nontrivial ordinary minimal blockers of size Cq from a random half-set for every fixed C. Weighted first-moment vanishing is a sufficient unproved enumeration route, not a necessary condition and not a consequence of minimality.
